lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular array of circular high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows between the first and second longitudinal ridges posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal carinae to form a grid where circular blobs are localized at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges on the upper lateral flank characterized by high pixel intensity on the superior edge and a sharp gradient to lower intensity (shadow) on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin on the upper body profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense patterning of smaller high-luminance spots on the surface of the visible right pectoral fin, particularly along its leading edge.
